cards.answer: Singed is a tank/mage with AP-scaling magic damage who leaves poison behind him and flings enemies behind himself.
cards.counterplay: Avoid chasing through his poison and keep your distance from Fling.

citations.quote: Name: Singed. Official role tags: Tank, Mage.
poison: The target continually takes magic damage over a short time.
Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed.

facts.claim: who leaves poison behind him and flings enemies behind himself.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing his poison and displacement helps avoid fighting on his terms.

cards.answer: Passing near champions grants Singed a temporary movement speed boost. Further passes refresh the boost and can stack it, but the same champion cannot trigger it again immediately.
cards.counterplay: Avoid clustering along his route through a fight.

citations.quote: Whenever Singed moves near a champion, he gains bonus movement speed for a short time

facts.claim: Passing near champions grants Singed a temporary movement speed boost.

citations.quote: which refreshes on subsequent passes and stacks up to a cap.
This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

facts.claim: Further passes refresh the boost and can stack it, but the same champion cannot trigger it again immediately.

cards.priority_reason: Explains his bursts of speed when moving through champions.

cards.answer: Poison Trail is a toggle that leaves lingering poison clouds behind Singed. Enemies in the clouds take magic damage over time, and renewed exposure refreshes the poison.
cards.counterplay: Move away from his trail instead of following through it.

citations.quote: Toggle: Singed continually creates a toxic cloud that shortly lingers in his wake

facts.claim: Poison Trail is a toggle that leaves lingering poison clouds behind Singed.

citations.quote: which continually inflicts poison to enemies within. poison: The target continually takes magic damage over a short time. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.

facts.claim: Enemies in the clouds take magic damage over time, and renewed exposure refreshes the poison.

cards.priority_reason: His persistent damage makes following his path dangerous.

cards.answer: Mega Adhesive creates a field that slows and grounds enemies inside.
cards.counterplay: Avoid the adhesive field and move out of it when caught.

citations.quote: Active: Singed creates a field of adhesive at the target location for a short time that grounds and slows enemies within.

facts.claim: Mega Adhesive creates a field that slows and grounds enemies inside.

cards.priority_reason: Its movement restrictions help Singed catch and control enemies.

cards.answer: Fling throws the targeted enemy behind Singed and deals magic damage partly based on their maximum health. Landing in Mega Adhesive also roots the target.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance from Singed, especially near his adhesive.

facts.claim: Fling throws the targeted enemy behind Singed and deals magic damage partly based on their maximum health.

citations.quote: If the target lands on Mega Adhesive, they are briefly rooted.

facts.claim: Landing in Mega Adhesive also roots the target.

cards.priority_reason: Displacement and the adhesive root can leave a target badly positioned.

cards.answer: Insanity Potion temporarily grants Singed ability power, armor, magic resistance, movement speed, and health and mana regeneration. While active, his Poison Trail also applies Grievous Wounds.
cards.counterplay: Back away during the boost and avoid prolonged fights in his poison.

citations.quote: Active: Singed empowers himself for some time with bonus ability power, bonus armor, bonus magic resist, bonus movement speed, bonus health regen, and bonus mana regen.

citations.quote: During this time, Poison Trail additionally applies Grievous Wounds.

cards.priority_reason: The broad stat boost changes his ability to chase and sustain a fight.
